title: Matrix-Free Local Multigrid for $C^1$ Hermite Discretizations on GPUs
summary: I present a matrix-free local multigrid method for $C^1$ tensor-product Hermite discretizations on adaptively refined Cartesian meshes, using the clamped biharmonic problem as the model problem. Extending a cell-wise primal-dual formulation to Hermite elements, I enforce continuity through a constraint operator that is never formed. At refinement edges, geometric prolongation supplies both the trace and its normal derivative, so the local V-cycle needs no edge operator and no hanging-node machinery.
